chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 503 – The Tribulation Ambush Plans – Seamless Gate’s Trap vs. Daofather Protection
chapter_meta_description: The Seamless Gate learns Ji Ning’s Primaltwin will face the Heavenly Tribulation and plots a deadly ambush. Ji Ning seeks refuge with the Xia Emperor, who promises to take him to a Daofather’s Dao-field.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 503 – The Hunters and the Hunted Both Prepare
og_description: Wuxiao and the Seamless Gate assemble avatars, Hell Death Warriors, and the Yin-Yang Mysterious Qi Bottle—but Ji Ning has a Daofather on speed dial. Who will strike first?
twitter_title: Desolate Era Ch. 503 – Ji Ning’s tribulation becomes the battlefield for a Daofather showdown
twitter_description: The Seamless Gate moves to ambush Ji Ning during his Heavenly Tribulation, but the Xia Emperor has two Daofathers waiting in reserve.

lore_anchors.definition: The final and most dangerous phase of the Heavenly Tribulation, where the cultivator’s mind is pulled into an illusory world of inner demons. Because the Primaltwin and true body share consciousness, both become helpless in reality.
A powerful unorthodox treasure in Wuxiao’s possession, capable of trapping and grinding even an Empyrean God to death. Once used to nearly kill a Heavenly Court deity.
Elite assassin teams of the Bloodcloud Tower, composed of cultivators trained for suicidal missions against powerful targets.
One of the supreme Daofathers of the Three Realms, openly ruling dozens of major worlds. He is the master of the Xia Emperor.
The sworn elder brother of the Xia Emperor, another Daofather who could provide sanctuary for Ji Ning.
A second body cultivated by a Ki Refiner at the Primal Daoist stage, sharing the same soul and consciousness. Its tribulation affects the true body.
